title: Plant Disease Spotting on Leaf Photos with Honest Field Tests
description: Trains a small classifier on leaf images and tests it on photos taken with a different phone and background, showing how much accuracy drops outside lab-style images and how augmentation helps.

title: Parking Lot Occupancy from a Single Fixed Camera
description: Marks parking bays once, classifies each as free or taken in every frame, smooths over time and compares accuracy across daylight, rain and night images. Includes a labelled test set of at least five hundred bay images and a table of per-condition errors.
